doan_van.ten: Ngữ pháp (40 điểm)
doan_van.noi_dung:
**Chia động từ (1–15):**

1. I ____ (never/be) to Japan.
1. She ____ (live) here since 2019.
1. They ____ (buy) a car last month.
1. English ____ (teach) in all schools here.
1. The bridge ____ (build) in 2015.
1. If it ____ (rain), we ____ (stay) home.
1. If I ____ (be) you, I ____ (accept) the job.
1. My phone ____ (repair) at the moment.
1. ____ you ____ (finish) your work yet?
1. I wish I ____ (have) more money.
1. He ____ (work) here for ten years and still works here.
1. The results ____ (announce) tomorrow.
1. You ____ (not/have to) come if you’re busy.
1. She ____ (must) wear a uniform at work. → dùng have to
1. I ____ (look) forward to ____ (meet) you.

**Chọn đáp án đúng (16–25):**
16. He’s (taller than / taller then) me.
17. You (mustn’t / don’t have to) smoke here. (cấm)
18. I’ve lived here (for / since) five years.
19. He has (been / gone) to the bank — he’s still there.
20. Could you tell me where (is the office / the office is)?
21. The man (who / which) works here is my boss.
22. Can I (borrow / lend) your pen?
23. I (can’t afford / don’t afford) it.
24. (Unless / If) you hurry, you’ll be late.
25. I look forward to (meet / meeting) you.

**Điền từ (26–35):** who, which, whose, where, for, since, must, mustn’t, should, unless
26. The woman ____ car was stolen called the police.
27. This is the café ____ we first met.
28. I’ve known him ____ 2015.
29. You ____ park here — it’s forbidden.
30. You ____ see a doctor if the pain continues.
31. ____ you leave now, you’ll miss the train.
32. The book ____ I bought was expensive.
33. She’s the person ____ helped me.
34. I’ve waited ____ two hours.
35. I ____ finish this today — it’s my own decision.

**Chuyển câu (36–40):**
36. They teach English here. → (bị động)
37. Bell invented the telephone. → (bị động)
38. Where is the station? → (câu hỏi gián tiếp với “Could you tell me…”)
39. I don’t have a car. → (I wish…)
40. If you don’t study, you’ll fail. → (dùng unless)

> Nam has worked as a software engineer for six years. He graduated from Hanoi University in 2019 and joined a small startup which was founded by two of his classmates. The company has grown a lot since then — it now employs over 200 people. Last year Nam was offered a job by a large international firm, but he turned it down. “If I left now, I would regret it,” he said. “This is the place where I learned everything. My skills were developed here.” He is currently in charge of a team which handles overseas clients. If the company continues to grow, he will be promoted to department manager next year.

1. How long has Nam worked as a software engineer?
1. Who founded the company?
1. What happened to Nam last year and what did he do?
1. Why didn’t he take the offer? (dùng câu điều kiện trong bài)
1. What is he responsible for now?

doan_van.noi_dung:
1. Mô tả một người bạn thân — ngoại hình, tính cách, so sánh với bạn (Unit 19)
1. Kể về kinh nghiệm làm việc/học tập của bạn — dùng present perfect và past simple đúng chỗ (Unit 23–24)

doan_van.ten: Mini-story - Một ngày bình thường tại nhà

mini_story.ten: Cảm động - Đôi bàn tay của chị
mini_story.truyen: Linh skips her favourite concert to finish the project for her brother. She sits alone in the dark room with a pile of heavy textbooks. Her eyes ache and her back feels stiff from sitting for six hours. She copies every complex diagram onto the large poster board carefully. Outside, the lively music starts without her presence. She finally places the last sticker on the colourful page. Exhaustion washes over her as she places the poster by the door. Her brother finds the finished work the next morning with a wide smile.
